card.name: Scholarly history and citation text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in academic history or politics prose, often right after a publication year in a bibliography or after a noun in a scholarly phrase.

modes.label: After a year in citations
modes.description: The closing bracket, comma or period right after a publication year in a reference list.

modes.label: Inside scholarly phrases
modes.description: A word in an essay on history, religion or politics, such as of, itself or notion.
